item.title: Refactor order status String into OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated inbox message): The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type.

- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit the work.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

pr.body: Adds src/status.rs: OrderStatus (Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled) with as_str, Display, FromStr (ParseStatusError, Error impl) and can_transition_to encoding pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled. Order::status is now OrderStatus; billing, shipping, order and report use the enum. status_counts returns Vec<(OrderStatus, usize)>, sorted by status name as before. Error messages, CSV lines and from_line errors are unchanged. Status literals appear only in src/status.rs. Tests: existing suite unchanged in behaviour, plus tests/status.rs covering names, parsing and the transition table. Checks: cargo test (9 tests pass), clippy -D warnings clean, fmt --check clean. Review: reviewer agt_01M8AJ3QJCZ8RB5D1QQYKE92AX passed with no findings. Assumption: public API changes (Order::status type, status_counts return type) are intended; downstream callers must update.
pr.summary: Made order status type-safe. Now: OrderStatus enum with lifecycle checks, parsing and display. Before: String status with literal comparisons. Behaviour, errors and report output unchanged.
